annotations.title: Prepare a Company Tax Return to file in the browser

description: Works out the Company Tax Return figures from the open DIYA-GL book, as derive_company_tax_return does, and answers a link to the Company Tax Return (CT600) form on DIY Accounting Submit with the period, the profit and loss account and the computation figures filled in. The person opens the link, looks up the company, checks the figures, fills the balance sheet and the rest of the return, and files there with their Government Gateway sign-in. Use this when the person asks to file their Company Tax Return or CT600. It never files anything and contacts no outside service.
name: prepare_company_tax_return
